summary: Trust Engine (Sprint 8) backend-only testing complete. 23/23 new pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_trust_engine.py covering: (1) engine invariants — WEIGHTS sum to 100, all 20 factors present, compute() shape/bounds, determinism (same input->same output), (2) GET /api/artisans/{aid}/trust incl. 404, (3) GET /api/artisans/{aid}/confidence-card returns only client-safe fields (verified/insured/business_registered/background_checked/avg_response_min/avg_arrival_min/completion_rate/satisfaction_rate/jobs_done/years_experience/emergency_capable/reasons FR/badges) and does NOT leak contributions/breakdown, (4) GET /api/artisans/{aid}/badges — top-rated seed (rating>=4.8) returns 'top_rated' gold; jobs tiers bronze/silver/gold/platinum are mutually exclusive, (5) GET /api/artisans/{aid} enriched with trust_score+badges+confidence_card, (6) GET /api/artisans/me/scoreboard — pro-only, 404 for clients, returns strengths(<=5)+improvements(<=5 with factor/label/current/potential_pts/recommendation)+badges+penalties, (7) POST /api/disputes — invalid severity 400, minor bumps disputes_resolved (auto_penalized, no manual review), severe requires_manual_review=true & status=open (NEVER auto-bans — artisan still returned by GET), moderate lowers trust score, (8) GET /api/disputes/mine for client & artisan roles, (9) POST /api/matching/smart-recommendations returns up to 5 alternatives with keys from {higher_rated,faster,closer,cheaper,earlier_slot} and NEVER returns the picked artisan, (10) POST /api/artisans/{aid}/recompute-trust idempotent + 404, (11) Startup persistence — all 12 seeded artisans have integer trust_score 0-100 and every backfilled Trust signal (identity_verified, insurance_verified, business_registered, years_experience, avg_arrival_min, punctuality_rate, satisfaction_rate, member_since, last_active_at, disputes_unresolved, disputes_resolved, emergency_capable). Regression: /api/properties/** still 27/27 pytest green (test_my_home.py). No frontend testing performed (per request: backend only).

minor.issue: Response omits the top-level 'confidence_level' + 'trust_score' explicitly (they ARE present via trust_engine.confidence_card, verified — OK). No functional issue; noting for completeness.

penalty['score_delta'] is stored on the dispute doc but the actual score reduction relies entirely on the recomputed feature vector via trust_engine.persist(). The stored score_delta is descriptive only and NOT applied — expected behavior per design (score is never editable), but worth confirming the field is documented as informational.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now >1500 lines — Trust Engine adds ~120 lines. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (trust_router.py, properties_router.py, missions_router.py) before it grows further.
trust_engine.py is a clean, self-contained ~540-line module — modular (WEIGHTS/PENALTIES/THRESHOLDS at top), pure functions, ML-ready via feature_vector(). Good separation of concerns.
compute() correctly clamps final to [0,100]; penalties applied after weighted sum; deterministic — verified.

Disputes: severe severity correctly sets requires_manual_review=true and status='open' — NEVER auto-bans (no delete/suspend on artisan doc). Verified by GET /api/artisans/{aid} still returning 200 after severe dispute.
Smart alternatives correctly filter picked_artisan_id from the pool and use best_by per axis — verified alt.artisan_id != picked in tests.
recompute-trust hooks wired on: POST /reviews, PATCH /bookings/{id}, POST /artisans/me, POST /disputes — all verified via code inspection at server.py lines 407, 509, 572, 1301.
Backfill on startup is idempotent ({"identity_verified": {"$exists": False}}) — safe on repeated boots.

success_rate.backend: 100% (23/23 new Trust Engine tests + 27/27 properties regression = 50/50)

seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed artisans + existing test users (client.test@auxora.fr, pro.test@auxora.fr). Test disputes created (reasons prefixed TEST_) are intentionally left to exercise the disputes_mine listing; they do not affect other flows since severe/moderate/minor all carry TEST_ prefix.

All 8 new endpoints (/api/artisans/{aid}/trust, /confidence-card, /badges, /recompute-trust, /api/artisans/me/scoreboard, /api/disputes, /api/disputes/mine, /api/matching/smart-recommendations) return correct shapes. Determinism, weights=100, 20 factors, severity=400 on invalid, severe NEVER auto-bans (manual_review=true, status=open), and startup persistence for 12 seeds all verified.
